statements.text: “No data centers in the desert,” said Democrat Jo Mendoza when asked about the sprawling computing facilities increasingly proposed for Arizona. “Not right now, not in our district, not in our state.”
statements.venue: Blog for Arizona article quoting Mendoza on data centers (CD6 campaign)

statements.text: We can’t have data centers near residential areas. We still don’t know what the public health risks are there. Arizona State University is doing research on air-cooled data centers, and what they found with those is that they still emit a lot of heat, anywhere between two to four degrees more
statements.venue: Blog for Arizona article quoting Mendoza on data centers (CD6 campaign)

statements.text: If data centers are being put up next to residential areas, what do you think is going to happen to people’s energy bills? Those energy bills are going to go up. And again, we don’t know what the impacts on health are going to be, especially in such close proximity
